name: Maeghan
source:
"I heard you made another foolish mistake, 'Prophet.'"

Nationality: Hathor
Role: King
Ability: Blue Flame manipulation

To Maeghan, supernatural power is not merely strength—it is sacred. A gift from the divine, proof of rightful supremacy.
She believes those who wield such power are destined to rule, and none more so than herself.

Wielding the legendary Blue Flames, she claims the title of the true sovereign—chosen to unite all nations under a single banner.

Among the Four Rulers, Maeghan has ruled the longest. Her flames have never dimmed. Neither has her ambition.

Her rule is not built on mercy.
It is forged in fire.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/yuri-eclipse/yuri-x-manga-x-visual-noveleclipse/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
